mentions.name: Digest
mentions.description: This service combines the sources you already follow — RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, YouTube, X, newsletters, weather, stocks — into one personal email delivered on your schedule. It now includes AI summaries for incoming newsletters, addressing the challenge of keeping a multi-source digest finite and useful.
mentions.problem: Once many followed sources are combined into a single email, keeping the results finite and useful is a challenge.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on Digest: https://usedigest.com

It lets you combine the things you already follow like RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, YouTube, X, newsletters, weather, stocks, etc. into one personal email delivered on your schedule.
